verdict.rationale: RUN documents letting new employees complete their own paperwork electronically before day one, including personal info, direct deposit, and Form W-4 [adp-run-docs-26]. It separately documents completing Form I-9 electronically during new-hire onboarding [adp-run-docs-29], so every element of the story is claimed in first-party docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the self-serve flow, explicit confirmation that I-9 sits in the same pre-day-one self-serve flow, and clarity on which package tier or add-on includes these features.
